name: ZETRIX
recent: Zetrix AI 近期面临重大财务与监管压力：公司确认无法偿还 20 亿令吉 sukuk，并因 JPJ 合约暂停预计营收将受 15% 冲击；同时政府就 3.14 亿令吉 JPJ 欠款提起诉讼，MARC 已将 sukuk 评级下调至违约。公司还撤回了派息计划，并有多项董事及委员会人事变动。
notable: 公司确认于11月6日对2500万令吉sukuk义务违约，并表示将进行结算。
政府就3.14亿令吉JPJ欠款对Zetrix AI提起诉讼。
公司表示目前无法偿还20亿令吉sukuk，并预计JPJ暂停将导致15%营收冲击。
risks: MARC将Zetrix AI的sukuk评级下调至违约，涉及未支付的2500万令吉。
公司面临政府就3.14亿令吉JPJ欠款提起的诉讼。
earnings: 最近一期财报（截至2026年6月30日）营收为4.267亿令吉，环比增长10.5%，同比增长38.6%；净利为2.693亿令吉，环比微降0.8%，同比增长35.2%；净利率为63.1%，低于上一期的70.2%。

recent_en: Zetrix AI is under significant financial and regulatory pressure: it confirmed inability to repay its RM2 billion sukuk and expects a 15% revenue hit from the JPJ suspension; the government has sued over RM314 million in JPJ arrears, and MARC has downgraded the sukuk to default. The company also withdrew its dividend plans and saw several board and committee changes.
notable_en: The company confirmed default on its RM25 million sukuk obligation on Nov 6 and committed to settlement.
The government has sued Zetrix AI over RM314 million in JPJ arrears.
The company said it is unable to repay its RM2 billion sukuk now and expects a 15% revenue hit from the JPJ suspension.
risks_en: MARC downgraded Zetrix AI's sukuk to default over unpaid RM25 million.
The company faces litigation from the government over RM314 million in JPJ arrears.
The company is unable to repay its RM2 billion sukuk, and AmanahRaya Investment Management has written off Zetrix AI sukuk across four funds.
earnings_en: For the latest reported period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM426.7 million, up 10.5% QoQ and 38.6% YoY; net income was RM269.3 million, down 0.8% QoQ but up 35.2% YoY; net margin was 63.1%, lower than 70.2% in the previous period.
